notes.title: Welcome to Aris & meet our publisher
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/f61af94dbdc2ef3c9410366743753917117ad675.png
Hey there!
We are so thrilled to share the game we’ve been working on for a long while. Aris Arcanum is born from our love of the gloomy vibes of Yharnam and the beauty of Elysium. Get ready to be lost in the grotesque halls of the endless ever-changing library to find death and beyond in there. 

Publisher Announcement
We are happy to announce that we teamed up with indie.io to let Aris Arcanum reach even more players. These guys helped lots of indie games to shine so we are lucky to have them on board.

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

Wishlist & Subscribe
Don’t forget to add Aris Arcanum to your Wishlists! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3006080/Aris_Arcanum/

Follow us on TikTok and join our Discord server to get more updates. See you in Aris!
